name: Sou3
title: Three Bamboo in a Vase
approval: Carl selected the left-hand vase painting from the three-bamboo triptych and explicitly requested GitHub deployment, then asked to retry. The young-shoots and moonlit-pond alternatives are not selected.
originalRetention: The original triptych and lossless selected crop are retained with the approval conversation. This repository contains the optimized approved artwork and provenance, not a full-resolution PNG archive.
processing: Mechanically extract the left panel at x=22,y=23,width=576,height=768, removing the white gutters, panel fringe and A label while retaining all three stalks and the complete vase. Uniformly resize this exact 3:4 crop with Pillow Lanczos to 300 x 400, then encode AVIF quality 70, speed 0, 4:2:0. No stretching, repainting or recolouring. The normal exporter places the image at 0,0,300,400, with zero extra bleed.
